findings.title: Native journal JSONB rejects both supported NUL fixtures
findings.detail: Both bodies ran once and passed output validation once; native confirm raised PostgreSQL22P05. Journal became UNCERTAIN, TOOL_RESULT NOT_APPLICABLE, first stop TOOL_FAILURE, one model call only. The required complete path fails despite green Vitest safe-uncertainty assertions. Neither domain exclusion nor codec/SQL change is authorized by this review.

findings.title: PG accounting is recorded more strongly than it is asserted by the frozen matrix
findings.detail: PG checks retain admissions, requests, responses, counters, CAS trace and physical/logical budgets; they do not explicitly assert per-call requestSha256/resultSha256, exact sum of usage, or physical decodedBytes/hash against loaded logical state. Memory positive observer asserts settled statuses and receipt totals. Independent offline recomputation verifies these additional properties for this actual run. A green matrix alone must not be used as a complete accounting/codec acceptance gate.

findings.title: Fresh native pool/factory is not process destruction or a published bound execution
findings.detail: The new pool and factory share the same Vitest process, synthetic capability/model closures and serving options. Seed request is an empty JSON object, and native adapters have no bound fence. The wrappers delegate unchanged native methods/errors; this is a real unbound public path, without exercising published guard enforcement. Native cross-tenant read denial is measured; cross-tenant write/corruption/concurrency controls are not established here.

findings.title: Additional physical-text SQL query used nonexistent context_version
findings.detail: The single frozen PG run succeeded. A subsequent read-only proof query failed42703 because the reviewer assumed context_version exists. Seven earlier commands in the read-only transaction recorded server identity, role attributes, ownership/grants and policies. Connection closed and finally stopped224. No retry, second frozen execution or source modification occurred. Direct SQL ::text/octet_length results were not obtained; physical checkpoint evidence comes from frozen native SELECT* snapshots and independent offline decoding. The source/mapped confirm result also distinguishes JSON null from absent result; no new direct JSONB-type SQL proof is claimed.
